agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
November 6, 2019 7:00 P.M.
Community Room – First Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
 ----------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda
  other than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for May 1,  June  5,  and  July  10,  2019
  Planning Commission meetings.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Betelehem
  Woldegiorgis, representing Nile Restaurant & Bar, for
  Special Use Permit No. 2019-011 (SP-2019-011) to allow 1)
  the on-site consumption of beer and wine, 2) the on-site
  consumption  of  distilled  spirits  and  3)  live-
  entertainment  within  a  proposed  restaurant  on  an
  approximately 8,625 square-foot, H-C (Historic Core)
  zoned property at 207 South Market Street.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice
  of Exemption EA-CE-2019-105; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt findings and
  the attached resolution approving Special Use
  Permit SP-2019-011 subject to conditions.

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Tanya
  Berenson, representing Los Angeles School of Gymnastics,
  for Special Use Permit No. 2019-012 (SP-2019-012) to allow
  a reduced parking requirement through the use of alternate
  modes of transportation for the development of an
  approximately 21,000 square-foot gymnastics facility in an
  existing structure on an approximately 38,115 square-foot,
  M-1(Light Manufacturing)zoned property at 720 South Hindry
  Avenue.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice
  of Exemption EA-CE-2019-119; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt Findings and
  the attached resolution approving SP-2019-012
  subject to conditions.
   c. A public hearing to consider an application by Norma
  Jones, for Zoning Code Amendment 2019-002 (ZCA-2019-002)
  to modify regulations of the Medical Enterprise Overlay
  Zone citywide.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation: Affirm Notice
  of Exemption EA-CE-2019-077; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt a resolution
  recommending City Council adoption of Zone Code
  Amendment ZCA-2019-002.

7.  NON - PUBLIC HEARINGS

  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by
  Betelehem Woldegiorgis, representing Nile Restaurant &
  Bar for Design Review No. 2019-008 (DR-2019-008) allow
  exterior improvements to an existing tenant space for a
  commercial building, H-C (Historic Core) zoned property
  at 207 South Market Street.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary  CEQA  Recommendation:  Affirm
  Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2019-105; and
  b. Preliminary Recommendation: Adopt findings and
  the attached resolution approving DR-2019-008
  subject to conditions.

8.  Commission Initiatives

9.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor,  Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations
must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información,
favor de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of November 6,
2019 is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or
other agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-
public hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to
the next regular Planning Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 4, 2019, 7:00 P.M.
  COMMUNITY ROOM, FIRST FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
